data.summary: MBA-qualified Business Analyst – Payments with 12+ years of experience in global payments operations, banking domain analysis, and cross-functional SDLC delivery. Proven ability to gather, analyse, and document business requirements across SWIFT payments, cross-border, domestic, and real-time payment workflows; prepare BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, process flows, and user stories; and support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and UAT. Strong domain expertise in Payment Management Systems (PMS), trade settlement, KYC/AML compliance, and payment transformation initiatives across global financial services environments.

Skilled in requirement lifecycle management, defect tracking, change management, and collaborating with business stakeholders, product owners, development, QA, and operations teams throughout the SDLC. Strong domain expertise in Payment Management Systems (PMS), trade settlement, KYC/AML compliance, and payment transformation initiatives across global financial services environments.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE	
Firstsource Solutions Ltd. (Client – US Bank, Lakeview Bank)	Aug 2019 – Mar 2025
Business Analyst – Payments & Financial Services Transformation	Bengaluru, India
Gathered, analysed, and documented business requirements across global payments and capital markets operational workflows; prepared BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, process flows, and user stories serving as authoritative delivery references for cross-functional SDLC delivery teams spanning business, technology, QA, and operations.
Analysed payment workflows involving domestic, cross-border, and settlement payment processes – mapping AS-IS and TO-BE payment flows, identifying process gaps, and documenting SWIFT messaging and Payment Management System (PMS) functional requirements with direct applicability to SWIFT MT/MX message types and ISO 20022 migration frameworks.
Supported Agile ceremonies – sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives – as an embedded domain SME, translating payment business requirements into user stories and acceptance criteria and maintaining end-to-end requirement lifecycle management across multiple concurrent payment transformation programmes.
Coordinated testing activities, defect tracking, and production readiness across full UAT lifecycle – designing test scenarios, managing defect triage with QA and development teams, and driving business sign-off – achieving zero critical post-go-live defects across multiple SDLC implementations.
Validated functional solutions against business requirements by reconciling system outputs against defined business rules and regulatory standards; ensured all payment processing requirements were met prior to production deployment through structured change management and sign-off governance.
Collaborated with business stakeholders, product owners, development, QA, and operations teams across global markets to facilitate requirement workshops, resolve conflicting priorities, and drive alignment on payment transformation initiative delivery outcomes.
Supported automation and digitisation within payments operations by documenting functional requirements and validat-ing Payment Management System outputs – directly contributing to Target Operating Model (TOM) enhancements and operational excellence programmes.
Mapped end-to-end customer/payment journeys across initiation, processing, exception handling and settlement, identifying pain points and process gaps to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
Mapped key payment business capabilities across domestic, cross-border and settlement processes, identifying capability gaps, dependencies and improvement opportunities to support payment transformation initiatives.
Conducted KYC/AML reviews and embedded regulatory controls into all payment process redesigns, contributing to zero audit findings across 5+ years and three successive compliance reviews.
Mapped end-to-end customer journeys for payment services, identifying customer pain points, operational handoffs and opportunities to simplify payment initiation, processing and exception-handling journeys.
Supported payment and settlement workflows associated with Investment Banking and Capital Markets operations, gaining exposure to trade processing, settlement, reconciliation and related payment flows
Mphasis Ltd. (Client – Charles Schwab)	Sep 2016 – Jul 2019
Senior Transaction Processing Officer – Payments & Banking Operations	Bengaluru, India
Analysed payment and settlement workflows across trade processing, investment banking, and mortgage loan operations; identified operational bottlenecks through structured gap analysis and recommended solutions that reduced manual processing errors across high-volume payments environments.
Performed data analysis and source-to-target reconciliation of financial transaction records across trading and settlement systems, validating payment data accuracy against business rules and regulatory standards – directly supporting payment validation and production readiness objectives.
Collaborated with onshore stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve process queries, and prepare management-level governance and compliance reports aligned to SLA and regulatory compliance frameworks.
HDFC Securities Ltd.	Aug 2014 – Sep 2016
Relationship Manager – Wealth & Investment Advisory	Bengaluru, India
Coordinated with back-office payments and settlement teams across the full trade lifecycle – trade execution, corporate actions, and custody reporting – gaining direct exposure to domestic payment workflows and settlement operations across BSE/NSE platforms.
Prepared daily MIS reports and portfolio performance analytics; managed client relationships across equities, fixed income, and derivatives with strong written and verbal communication.
Shilpa Stock Brokers Pvt. Ltd.	Jul 2012 – Jul 2014
Client Relationship Executive – Equity & Capital Markets	Rourkela, India
Supported trade execution, settlement tracking, and client account maintenance on BSE/NSE platforms; provided information on trading and settlement processes, order placement, and trade confirmations.
